# UNIGATES

> UNIGATES is an Arabic/English educational platform by Dar Obeid offering online courses, a book store, and a school/university platform for students, teachers, and institutions.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of UNIGATES platform and its sectors.
- [About](/about): About UNIGATES and Dar Obeid.
- [Courses](/courses): Online courses catalog.
- [Book Store](/book-store): Digital and printed book store.
- [School Platform](/school-platform): K-12 school management platform.
- [University Platform](/university-platform): Higher-education platform for colleges and institutes.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles and platform news.
- [FAQ](/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Help Center](/help-center): User support resources.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact information.
- [Partnerships](/partnerships): Partnership opportunities.

## Optional

- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
